scenes.vo: There are only four numbers in my case. Most people don't believe the fourth one.
Twenty-six. My age when they arrested me, 1996.

scenes.vo: Three years, eleven months. How long I was inside.
Five. Every justice on the South Carolina Supreme Court, saying the same thing: it should have been impossible to convict me. Zero dissents.

scenes.vo: Seventy-seven. The days the State kept me locked up after that order.

scenes.vo: Seventy-seven is also the number of days between the opinion that freed me and the version they filed in its place. Withdrawn. Refiled. Language deleted.
My lawyer, Dan Stacey, gave me one instruction before he died: get those words into a record nobody can edit.
This is that record. Clearly Established. Link in bio. Comment which number stopped you.
